title: Klandicar (Seasonal)
summary: Answer Klandicar's movement warnings and shatter the ice that protects and strengthens him.
overview: Answer Klandicar's movement warnings and shatter the ice that protects and strengthens him.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Distinguish the danger ring from the safe ring and move to the marked location, not a moving boss.
Prioritize tombs and the 45% shard immediately.

phases.label: Ice mechanics
phases.description: Alternate fixed Fracture danger, fixed Whiteout safety and breakable tombs.

phases.label: Priority Shard
phases.description: Remove the shard that amplifies mechanic damage.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Ice Fracture marks a fixed impact point: move everyone at least 32 feet away during the eight-second warning.
Whiteout marks a fixed safe center: gather within 65 feet before the eight-second warning ends.
Destroy a Glacial Tomb to free its prisoner; only one tomb can stand at a time.
At 75%, clear the scaled guardian wave within 75 seconds or Klandicar regains 8% health.
At 45%, destroy the Priority Glacial Shard to remove its 35% mechanic-damage increase. At 20%, mechanics accelerate and gain another 25% damage.
A wipe clears adds and roots and restores the boss.
